title: 第一卷 第13章 你给明月道个歉第一卷 第14章 本尊全会耶
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
一想到云爻跪在自己脚边的场景，苏明月就兴奋得浑身发颤。
“有这么开心？”
青年轻轻掐了把少女柔软的腰肢，说：“五日后将有一个秘境试炼。宗门元婴期以下弟子皆要参加，她那法器太逆天，到时候肯定被禁不能用，这也是你的一次机会。”
“师兄，我会努力的~”
苏明月嘤咛一声，顺势倒在了青年的怀中。
洛还真在止云峰玩了整整一天。
直到天黑，才哼哧哼哧爬到云爻为她准备的小竹床上闭眼睛睡觉。
木屋四周灵气像是被指引着一般朝洛还真蜂拥而去，形成一个不小的风暴，争抢着进入她体内。
而风暴中心，小小的奶娃娃睡得香甜，像只可爱的猪崽。
云爻站在不远处看着这一幕，心里庆幸洛还真被自己留下。
这种天资和福缘，说是天道亲闺女都不为过。
能养在玄天宗，是全宗门的福气。
云爻没养过孩子。
很是稀奇地看了一会儿洛还真的睡颜，她睫毛很长很翘，像个可爱的人偶娃娃。
只是现在这个人偶娃娃并不美丽，她的脸上全是漆黑可怖的伤疤，整个人瘦不拉几没几两肉。
这十年，苦了她了。
云爻摇了摇头，转身欲走。
就在这时床上被灵气萦绕的孩子突然发出了低低的啜泣声。
“坏魔魔，不要、不要欺负真真……大师兄……你在哪里……师尊，真真好怕……怕……”
小小的孩子，缩作一团，在梦中无助地哭泣。

云爻离开的动作一顿。
他跨出一步，瞬间来到洛还真的小竹床边。
犹豫片刻后，云爻学着当初师尊照顾年幼时的自己一般，弯身将她抱在了怀中。
似乎是感受到温暖，洛还真的哭泣声小了些。
只不过小短手却无意识地拽紧面前人的衣襟，似乎是生怕他突然消失又丢下自己一人。
云爻不慎熟练地一下一下，轻拍怀中孩子的背。
“不怕，真真不怕。师尊在……”
翌日。
洛还真揉着眼睛，打了个大大的哈欠。
不对……哪里来的温暖宽厚的怀抱？
洛还真倏地睁大眼睛。
她看看自己，又看看抱着自己的这位眼底一片乌青，看上去十分疲惫的青衫美男，嘴上的哈欠凝滞了一半，一脸不解。
“哈，师尊？你怎么在这里。”
云爻生睁开青墨色的眸子，放开洛还真，问道：“睡得好吗？”
洛还真老实巴交地点头。
她好久没有睡过这么安心和舒服的觉了。
云爻：“……今日，真真先在宗门自己玩会儿，师尊咳咳，师尊要研习一下如何教你重修。”
洛还真很想说不用研习。
她很聪明的，只要是有关修行的知识，她天生就什么都听得懂。
但是见云爻似乎很期待她去玩儿，只好点点头，乖巧道：“好~”

看着小短腿一蹦一跳地离开止云峰，朝山下跑去，云爻这才低下头，掀开自己乱糟糟的青衫看。
青紫色的拳头印，血淋淋的牙齿印、小脚板印，印的满满当当……
content_en:
Su Mingyue was so excited that she trembled at the thought of Yun Yao kneeling at her feet.
"Are you so happy?"
The young man gently pinched the girl's soft waist and said: "There will be a secret trial in five days. All disciples below the Yuan Ying stage of the sect must participate. Her magic weapon is so unbelievable that it will definitely be banned and cannot be used by then. This is also your chance."
"Brother, I will work hard~"
Su Mingyue let out a cry and fell into the young man's arms.
Luo Huan really spent a whole day playing at Zhiyun Peak.
It wasn't until dark that she crawled onto the small bamboo bed prepared by Yun Yao and closed her eyes to sleep.
The spiritual energy around the wooden house swarmed towards Luo Huanzhen as if being guided, forming a big storm, competing to enter her body.
At the center of the storm, the little baby baby slept soundly, like a cute piglet.
Yun Yao stood not far away and watched this scene, feeling glad that Luo was really left behind by him.
With such talent and good fortune, it would be no exaggeration to say that she is the daughter of Heaven.
Being able to be raised in Xuantian Sect is a blessing for the whole sect.
Yun Yao has never raised any children.
I was very surprised to see Luo Huan's sleeping face for a while. Her eyelashes were very long and curled, like a cute doll.
It's just that this doll is not beautiful now. Her face is covered with dark and terrifying scars, and she is very skinny and has very little flesh.
These ten years have been hard on her.
Yun Yao shook his head and turned to leave.
At this moment, the child who was surrounded by spiritual energy on the bed suddenly let out a low sob.
"Bad Demon, don't, don't bully Zhenzhen... Senior Brother... Where are you... Master, Zhenzhen is so scared... Afraid..."
The little child huddled up and cried helplessly in his sleep.
Yun Yao paused before leaving.
He took a step and came to Luo Huanzhen's bedside in an instant.
After hesitating for a moment, Yun Yao imitated the way his master had taken care of him when he was young, and bent down to hold her in his arms.
As if feeling the warmth, Luo actually cried less.
However, her short hands unconsciously tightened the clothes of the person in front of her, as if she was afraid that he would suddenly disappear and leave her alone.
Yun Yao accidentally and skillfully patted the child in her arms on the back.
"I'm not afraid, I'm really not afraid. Master is here..."
The next day.
Luo Hua really rubbed his eyes and yawned loudly.
No...where did the warm and generous embrace come from?
Luo Huan's eyes widened suddenly.
She looked at herself, and then at the beautiful man in green shirt who was holding her with dark eyes and looking very tired. Half of the yawn on his mouth was frozen, with a puzzled look on his face.
"Ha, Master? Why are you here?"
Yun Yaosheng opened his green eyes, let go of Luo Huanzhen, and asked, "Did you sleep well?"
Luo nodded honestly.
She hadn't slept so peacefully and comfortably for a long time.
Yun Yao: "...Today, Zhenzhen will play by himself in the sect for a while. Master, ahem, Master wants to study how to teach you to re-cultivate."
Luo really wanted to say that there was no need to study.
She is very smart, as long as it is knowledge about spiritual practice, she is born to understand everything.
But seeing that Yunyao seemed to be looking forward to her playing, he could only nod his head and said obediently: "Okay~"
Seeing her short legs jumping away from Zhiyun Peak and running down the mountain, Yun Yao lowered her head and lifted up her messy green shirt to take a look.
There are purple fist prints, bloody teeth prints, and small footprints all over the place...
